weeks.content:
Bones, muscles and blood
Milk, eggs and beans build me

Brush twice, spit, do not swallow
Visit the dentist yearly

Good light for reading
Rest eyes between play

Do not put sticks in ears
Clean outside with a towel

Cough spreads germs
Cover mouth and wash hands

Mosquitoes bite at dusk
Sleep under treated nets

Drink clean water
Cover food from flies

Look left, right and left again
Use the zebra crossing

Record my height and weight
Know my growth

Health talk by the nurse
Health habits certificates
